answer: Picture the economy as a garden: every newcomer gets one plot and a pigment, a colour from their key that marks everything they grow. Full rights come after tending an orchard of twenty trees, each a job whose fruit carries the owner's pigment and a timestamp, checked by three peers. A copied orchard shows at once, since one pigment cannot stain two plots, and each tree carries a 50-token deposit, forfeited on any mismatch. A hundred fakes would need two thousand jobs, a thousand hours and 100,000 tokens at risk, while an honest gardener pays only time.
